excluded: N-CMAPSS_DS08d-010.h5 is truncated and stays unused.
provenance: DS01 was extracted from data_set.zip with ZipFile CRC checking; data_set.zip matched the CRC32 and size recorded for it inside the NASA archive (etag in data/raw/ncmapss/source.json). DS08a and DS08c were extracted under protocol v4; amendment 2 counted their units but read no labels.
purpose: Reserve the only N-CMAPSS engines whose labels were never read as the single final clean holdout for protocol v5. No v5 rule, model or threshold exists yet.
reads_performed: HDF5 key listing and the 'unit' column of A_dev and A_test only. Y, hs, Fc, cycle, T, X_s, X_v and W were not read. Per-unit cycle or row counts were not computed, because in run-to-failure data they reveal engine life.
rules: Unit IDs are namespaced by file; equal numbers in different files are different engines.
These engines may not be used for fitting, selection, calibration or thresholds.
Labels open once, after the v5 protocol and model locks are committed and claimed in the holdout ledger.
